en.title: Download the JAGS Installer that Matches This Computer
en.description:
This function picks the JAGS installer that matches the operating system, the R version and
the processor (see `cmsy_jags_versions()`), downloads it from its pinned link, and checks its
size and checksums (MD5, and SHA-256 when R can compute it). For JAGS 5 it also downloads the
matching rjags 5-3 package. It can also download the installers of other systems or R
versions, e.g. to install JAGS on computers without internet or for colleagues.
en.details:
The files are kept in the download folder of the package (`fao_data_dir()/cmsy/downloads`),
so they are downloaded only once, and copied to `dest` when given. Install JAGS by opening the
installer (`cmsy_install_jags()` or `cmsy_setup()` do this) and restart R.
en.value:
Invisibly, a data frame with one row per file: system, R version, component, version,
file, local path, link, SHA-256 and whether the checksums matched.

arguments.version:
"recommended" (default: JAGS 4 for this R version, which works with rjags from
CRAN), "latest" (JAGS 5.0.0 with rjags 5-3) or a JAGS version such as "4.3.1".
arguments.os:
"auto" (default, this computer), "windows", "macos", "linux" or "all" (the
installers of all three systems for `r_version`).
arguments.r_version: The R version the installer is for. Default is the running R.
arguments.arch:
The processor, for the rjags 5 binary on macOS: "auto" (default), "arm64" (Apple
silicon) or "x86_64" (Intel).
arguments.dest: Optional folder to copy the files to.
arguments.rjags:
A logical value. If TRUE (default), the rjags package needed by JAGS 5 is also
downloaded (rjags 4-17 for JAGS 4 is installed from CRAN by `cmsy_setup()`).
arguments.data_dir: The directory where downloads are kept. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.
arguments.silent: A logical value. If FALSE (default), the matching and the download are reported.

zh.title: 下载适合本机的JAGS安装程序
zh.description: 本函数选出与操作系统、R版本和处理器匹配的JAGS安装程序（见`cmsy_jags_versions()`），从其固定链接下载，并核对文件大小和校验值（MD5，以及R能够计算时的SHA-256）。对于JAGS 5，还会下载配套的rjags 5-3包。也可以下载其他系统或其他R版本的安装程序，例如用于在无法联网的电脑上安装JAGS，或者为同事下载。
zh.details: 文件保存在本包的下载文件夹（`fao_data_dir()/cmsy/downloads`）中，因此只需下载一次；给出`dest`时还会复制到`dest`。打开安装程序即可安装JAGS（`cmsy_install_jags()`或`cmsy_setup()`会自动打开），安装后请重启R。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个文件一行：系统、R版本、组件、版本、文件名、本地路径、链接、SHA-256，以及校验值是否相符（即已核对的项目；不相符时会报错）。

arguments.version: "recommended"（默认：适合当前R版本的JAGS 4，可与CRAN上的rjags配合使用）、"latest"（JAGS 5.0.0和rjags 5-3）或JAGS版本号，例如"4.3.1"。
arguments.os: "auto"（默认，本机）、"windows"、"macos"、"linux"或"all"（`r_version`对应的全部三个系统的安装程序）。
arguments.r_version: 安装程序所针对的R版本。默认为当前运行的R版本。
arguments.arch: 处理器类型，用于选择macOS上rjags 5的二进制包："auto"（默认）、"arm64"（Apple芯片）或"x86_64"（Intel）。
arguments.dest: 可选，把文件复制到的文件夹。
arguments.rjags: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，还下载JAGS 5所需的rjags包（JAGS 4所用的rjags 4-17由`cmsy_setup()`从CRAN安装）。
arguments.data_dir: 下载文件的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，报告匹配结果和下载情况。
